newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunker losses draw rest of Europe down.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunker losses draw rest of Europe down.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices fell again on Monday, while bunkers in the rest of Europe struggled to keep pace with ARA's recent weakness, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was quoted at around $89 fob by the close, down $2 on the day. Barges traded as low as $85 fob ARA, $5 a tonne lower than at Friday's close.
Suppliers said total ARA volume was around 10,000 tonnes, including two enquiries of over 2,000 tonnes each for 180 CST. Many buyers were convinced the market would fall further.
Hamburg bunkers fell by $1, but quotes were still about $8 above Rotterdam levels. Buyers were uninterested.
"It's been pretty quiet. Everyone knows we have to go down more, but we can't move down that fast," one supplier said.
Mediterranean prices were between $1 and $3 down, the greatest falls coming in Spain.
Egyptian prices fell by $4 a tonne with limited availability in Alexandria.
Fujairah fell by $2. Business showed signs of improvement.
